span.label: Whether novel relational information presented below awareness is stored well enough to bias a conscious decision made twenty minutes later.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: multi-item subliminal displays force relational binding, which recruits the hippocampus; hippocampal plasticity encodes the relation in a single exposure and holds it for the long term
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: single familiar items are processed by neocortex, which needs many learning trials to lay down a trace, which is why earlier subliminal priming effects decayed within a second or accumulated only slowly
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed route is relational binding in the hippocampal system, which can encode novel relations rapidly and hold them durably
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: That predicts the opposite of the usual expectation - subliminal effects should last longer when the material is novel and must be bound, not when it is familiar and repeated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the second experiment the same logic is applied to word meaning: a subliminal German word must be decoded and linked to a foreign word for the later judgement to work
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Awareness is ruled out four ways rather than one: interview, two objective tests, Bayes factors, and a regression on residual awareness
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A stricter check: removing every participant whose awareness score deviated from chance in either direction, and confirming the effect survives
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paradigm cannot establish what kind of memory was formed - precise semantic relations or only fuzzy semantic/affective associations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In experiment 2 the Bayes analysis of the awareness test was inconclusive, so true unawareness of the subliminal words was not established.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The awareness test for experiment 2 may simply have been insensitive rather than showing absence of awareness.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Awareness was not probed trial-by-trial during the main experiments, so brief awareness of some stimuli cannot be excluded.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors state plainly that a non-significant awareness test does not establish unawareness, and this is why they compute Bayes factors
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In Experiment 2 that check came back inconclusive and is reported as such - awareness could not be excluded
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The conclusion for Experiment 2 is therefore explicitly left open on the awareness question
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The regression method used to separate awareness from effect is cited together with the criticism of it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The effects are a few percentage points above chance in both experiments
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The Experiment 2 effect rests on a p just under .05
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: twenty additional faces paired with CONSONANT STRINGS and presented subliminally as a control condition - AND THE PAPER MARKS IT `(not reported)`
span.note: eliminates: that the long-term preference follows from subliminal exposure to ANY paired string rather than to the message - consonant strings carry no meaning, and the paper marks the condition `(not reported)` in its own parentheses · would have ruled out, had it been run: the subliminal presentation itself as the source of the later wage judgement: if faces paired with meaningless consonant strings produced the same effect, the occupation words would not be doing the work
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a non-significant awareness test - as ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE: the test may simply have been too insensitive, which proves nothing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a non-significant awareness test - as EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE: a Bayes factor below one third, which is what Experiment 1 obtained
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same test in Experiment 2 - INCONCLUSIVE: a factor near one, favouring neither hypothesis, and reported rather than glossed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: subliminal effect - the received view: decays within about a second, which is why it is thought harmless
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: subliminal effect - as found here: undiminished at 25 minutes compared with 15, for novel relational material
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: phenomenon: long-term subliminal influence on delayed decision-making
span.note: a second reading reaching the same value. Recorded: long-term subliminal influence on delayed decision-making — a second reading reaching the same value from a different sentence. Not applied - a person decides.

span.label: Faces that had been subliminally paired with high- or low-wage occupations were later consciously rated as high or low earners at 53.97% accuracy, above the 50% chance level.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Subliminally encoded semantic associations still steered conscious decisions almost thirty minutes later.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The subliminal effect was no weaker after a 25-minute delay than after 15 minutes, so it did not measurably decay over that range.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Subliminally presented pseudoword-translation pairs let participants judge later whether a foreign word matched a synonym of its translation, at 52.7% accuracy versus 50% chance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Objective forced-choice tests in experiment 1 gave substantial Bayesian evidence that participants could not perceive the masked faces or occupations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In experiment 2 the Bayes factor of 1.14 was inconclusive, so the awareness test there could not rule stimulus awareness out.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Awareness-test accuracy did not predict decision accuracy, indicating the delayed effect was not carried by residual conscious perception.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
